guest-live.name: Guest during a live round
guest-live.headline: Read more. Listen more. Keep going together.
guest-live.lede: Tadoku turns language immersion into friendly seasonal contests. Log what you read and listen to, watch your score grow, and build a habit that outlasts the round.
guest-live.fineprint: Free to join · Registration closes 23 September

member-open.lede: Choose the languages you want to immerse in, join the official round, and let the community’s progress give your daily habit a little extra pull.
member-open.fineprint: Joining a contest and logging activity are separate steps

participant-live.name: Registered participant during a live round
participant-live.headline: Keep your immersion moving.
participant-live.lede: You’re 12th with 136 points. Log today’s reading or listening and follow the friendly pace of everyone immersing alongside you.
participant-live.fineprint: Scores may take a few seconds to update

upcoming.name: Registration is open before a round
upcoming.headline: The next round starts 1 November.
upcoming.lede: Pick your language now, decide what you want to read or listen to, and start the next two-week immersion sprint with the community.

between.name: Between official rounds
between.headline: Keep immersing between rounds.
between.lede: Contests add momentum, but the habit is yours year-round. Track what you read and listen to today, then bring that rhythm into the next official round.
between.fineprint: You can track progress without joining a contest

unavailable.name: Contest data is temporarily unavailable
unavailable.headline: Your immersion can keep going.
unavailable.lede: The current contest board is temporarily unavailable. You can still log reading and listening now; submitted activity will appear when updates resume.
unavailable.fineprint: Demo scenario: logging is available; only standings are delayed
